name: Sihai's Legacy
source:
Sihai's Legacy is (and will be) a game about choice. You will make a decision between five romance-able men and come to learn more about them! As you work alongside them, your relationship will flourish and blossom... or perhaps fizzle out. But beneath the surface, there's even more going on... and it will be up to you to get to the bottom of it. From mysterious strangers to the magical "Paragons," there's more than meets the eye about this world. Tread carefully!

[From [url=https://iglootheraptor.itch.io/sihais-legacy]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《四海的遗产》是（也将是）一款关于选择的游戏。你将在五个有浪漫天赋的男人之间做出选择，并进一步了解他们！当你与他们一起工作时，你们的关系将会蓬勃发展……或者可能会失败。但在表面之下，还有更多的事情正在发生……而这将取决于你是否能弄清真相。从神秘的陌生人到神奇的“典范”，这个世界的魅力远不止你所看到的那么简单。小心踩！

[来自[url=https://iglootheraptor.itch.io/sihais-legacy]Itch.io[/url]]
